name: What is included in an AI SEO website audit report?

mainEntity.name: What is included in an AI SEO website audit report?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI SEO website audit report typically includes an executive summary, detailed findings on technical SEO (e.g., crawlability, site speed, mobile-friendliness), content analysis (e.g., semantic relevance, topic authority, schema markup), user experience insights, and competitive analysis. It provides prioritized, actionable recommendations for optimizing your website to perform better in AI-driven search results, enhancing visibility and organic traffic.
acceptedAnswer.description: An AI SEO website audit report covers technical SEO, content, user experience, and competitive analysis, offering actionable recommendations for AI search optimization.
